title: Housekeeping Charges Schedule: Extra Linen Share of the Extra-Guest Fee
content:
# Housekeeping charges schedule — extra linen for additional guests

**Schedule term.** On a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, once the extra guests have arrived, part of the extra-guest fee pays for the extra linen set up for them and is kept: a cancellation dated on the check-in date keeps 10 percent of the refundable extra-guest fee; a cancellation dated after the check-in date keeps 15 percent of it; a cancellation before the check-in date keeps none. The linen share is taken from the refundable extra-guest fee before the extra-guest-fee refund is rounded to the cent.

| Cancellation date compared with the check-in date | Linen share kept |
|---|---|
| before | none |
| same day | 10 percent |
| after | 15 percent |

## Both sides of check-in (hypothetical refundable extra-guest fee of 80.00)

| Cancellation dated | Kept | Returned |
|---|---|---|
| the day before check-in | 0.00 | 80.00 |
| the check-in date | 8.00 | 72.00 |
| the day after check-in | 12.00 | 68.00 |
